jsonLd.description:
About
**About **
Bellevue Towers Apartments is a beautifully maintained eight-storey building comprising 44 spacious one- and two-bedroom suites. Each bright, generously sized unit offers stunning views, thoughtfully restored and modernized kitchens and bathrooms, and includes heat and hot water for your comfort.
Ideally situated at 4639 West 10th Avenue in Vancouver’s desirable West Point Grey neighbourhood, Bellevue Towers Apartments provides residents with convenient access to major transit routes, ensuring quick and easy commutes to the vibrant downtown core.
